title: TCC — telemetria e ciclos
description: Base de integração. simulation contém fixtures de transporte, sem dinâmica agronômica. Selecionar fonte e experimento explicitamente.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experimento
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id AS __text, experiment_id AS __value FROM telemetry WHERE source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

options.content: Origem selecionada: **$source**. Experimento: **$experiment**. Dados simulation são fixtures de transporte; não representam ensaio físico ou desempenho de ML.

targets.rawSql: SELECT collected_at AS time, soil_index AS value, device_id AS metric FROM telemetry WHERE source = ${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND sensor_valid AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at
SELECT count(*) AS messages FROM telemetry WHERE source = ${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

SELECT c.issued_at, c.payload->>'unit_id' AS vaso, c.payload->>'treatment' AS tratamento, c.status, c.payload->>'reason' AS motivo, c.command_id FROM commands c WHERE c.source = ${source:sqlstring} AND c.payload->>'experiment_id' = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(c.issued_at) ORDER BY c.issued_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Água retirada e energia por ciclo confirmado

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.occurred_at, c.payload->>'unit_id' AS vaso, e.payload->>'volume_ml' AS agua_ml, e.payload->>'energy_wh' AS energia_wh, e.payload->>'measurements_valid' AS medicao_valida, e.payload->>'reason' AS motivo FROM command_events e JOIN commands c USING(command_id) WHERE c.source = ${source:sqlstring} AND c.payload->>'experiment_id' = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND e.status IN ('completed','failed') AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT d.created_at, d.payload->>'reason' AS motivo, d.payload->>'actuate' AS irrigar, d.payload->>'prediction_id' AS previsao, d.payload->>'command_id' AS comando FROM decisions d JOIN telemetry t ON t.device_id=d.device_id AND t.message_id=(d.payload->>'telemetry_message_id')::uuid WHERE t.source = ${source:sqlstring} AND t.experiment_id = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(d.created_at) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
